bandwidth.note: WebSocket payload bytes (protocol frames); no WS/TCP/TLS framing; sessions of at least 5 s

clientTick.note: measured by the clients during the steady window; includes harness scheduling noise (the harness shares the host)

coldStart.note: process spawn to GET /control/health = 200, and to the public port accepting TCP

server.metricsNote: cumulative since server start (a fresh server per run); stepUs is one room's simulation step, per step; quantiles are histogram bucket upper bounds (<= 25% above true); there is no server-side p95
